blocks.heading: Research Associate and JRF Pay
rows: Industry research associate, BSc entry
Roughly Rs 2.5-5.5 LPA (about Rs 21,000-41,000/month), the most common first job after a biotech or life-science BSc.
Industry research associate, MSc entry
Roughly Rs 3-6.2 LPA. The bump from BSc to MSc is real but modest - the function you enter still moves the number more than the degree.
CSIR/UGC Junior Research Fellowship (JRF)
A fixed government stipend, currently around Rs 37,000/month (roughly Rs 4.4 LPA equivalent) for the first two years of a funded PhD, plus HRA and institutional benefits.
Senior Research Fellowship (SRF), after 2 years
Upgrades to roughly Rs 42,000/month (about Rs 5 LPA equivalent), conditional on clearing a departmental assessment.
DBT-Research Associateship (postdoctoral)

A separate, senior fellowship for postdoctoral researchers, commonly cited in the Rs 47,000-55,000/month range plus HRA depending on the scheme and notification year - always confirm the currently notified rate before applying, since fellowship amounts get revised.

blocks.heading: Bioinformatics Analyst Pay
rows: Entry, national average
Roughly Rs 3.4-6.3 LPA (Glassdoor 25th-75th percentile), with an overall average close to Rs 5.2-5.5 LPA across sources.
Entry, Bengaluru
Averages meaningfully higher than the national figure - commonly cited near Rs 6.25 LPA, reflecting the concentration of genomics and pharma-informatics employers there.
Experienced, strong pipeline depth

Reports for experienced bioinformatics roles with real NGS-pipeline, cloud, and scripting depth run considerably higher, commonly Rs 10-16+ LPA, and higher still at global genomics or pharma-tech companies.

blocks.heading: DBT Scientist Pay: the Government Science Route
rows: ICAR - Agricultural Research Service (ARS) Scientist, entry
Level 10 basic pay Rs 57,700/month; the related SMS/STO posts start at Rs 56,100/month - both under the 7th CPC pay matrix.
CSIR Scientist, entry (post-PhD)
Level 10 basic pay Rs 56,100/month, with in-hand pay commonly reported around Rs 91,500-96,600/month once DA and city-linked HRA are added - roughly Rs 9-11.6 LPA gross depending on city class.
DBT-funded project scientist / RA

Pay follows the specific fellowship or project-scientist scheme rather than one fixed government pay matrix - commonly in the Rs 47,000-55,000/month band for postdoctoral associateships, but always verify the current notified amount for the specific call.
Career progression (CAS)

Government scientists move through Career Advancement Scheme grades over a full career, reaching Rs 15-25+ LPA gross at senior scientist and above, well before counting pension-linked security most private roles do not match.

blocks.heading: Serum Institute, and Dr. Reddy's Actually Pay
rows: Biocon Limited (Bengaluru)
Junior Executive/QC Executive roles average Rs 3.9-4.1 LPA, typically Rs 2-5.3 LPA
Senior Scientist averages Rs 6.9 LPA (Rs 4.8-10.6 LPA); Principal Scientist averages Rs 10.2 LPA; Associate Director averages Rs 35.6 LPA
Company-wide average across roughly 10,900 reported salaries is about Rs 8.5 LPA (AmbitionBox).
Syngene International (Bengaluru, Biocon's research-services arm)
Research Associate and fresher R&D roles commonly Rs 4.2-5.8 LPA, typically Rs 2.5-6.6 LPA
Mid-senior scientific and delivery roles average roughly Rs 12-17 LPA (8-18 years); a 9-22 year senior band averages Rs 35.2 LPA (Rs 21-47 LPA)
Company-wide average across roughly 11,400 reported salaries is about Rs 9.0 LPA (AmbitionBox).
Serum Institute of India (Pune)
Trainee/production roles commonly Rs 3.3-3.65 LPA
Assistant Manager level averages roughly Rs 11-11.9 LPA
Figures from Glassdoor India and Indeed India; Serum Institute discloses fewer role-level salary breakdowns publicly than Biocon or Syngene, so treat this as a narrower sample.
Dr. Reddy's Laboratories (Hyderabad)
Early-career Research Scientist pay averages roughly Rs 6.9 LPA
Mid-career Research Scientist pay averages roughly Rs 7.8 LPA

The company-wide reported average (blending corporate, commercial, and R&D roles) runs far higher, near Rs 21-23 LPA - a reminder that a whole-company average is not a realistic fresher benchmark (Payscale India, 6figr).

blocks.heading: Regulatory Affairs Pay: the Quiet High-Ceiling Track

items.text: Roughly Rs 2.6-4.4 LPA at the 25th-75th percentile (Glassdoor India), for dossier compilation, labelling checks, and submission support under supervision.
The broader "regulatory affairs" title (mixing junior and senior roles) averages closer to Rs 5.5 LPA, with a wide Rs 3.2-9 LPA spread.
Senior Regulatory Affairs roles commonly run Rs 8-12 LPA once you can own a full submission independently.
